en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor swimming pool set in a forested mountain landscape. In the middle ground is a rectangular pool with people on the deck and a low pavilion‑style building on one side. Meadows and trees surround the pool, and wooded hills and higher mountains rise in the background. German caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.
